idea-plugin.name: Console Emulation Toggle
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a one-click toggle for the Emulate terminal in output console option of Python run configurations, without opening the Run/Debug Configurations dialog.

Some scripts need a real terminal: progress bars, curses interfaces, coloured output and libraries that check isatty(). Others are easier to read and search in the plain output console. This plugin makes switching between the two a single click.

The toggle appears in two places:

  • Main toolbar (right side): changes the run configuration currently selected in the run widget.
  • Run and Debug tool window toolbar: changes the configuration that tab was started from. Click Rerun to apply it right away.

The option belongs to each run configuration, so each one keeps its own value. A change takes effect the next time the configuration runs; a process that is already running is not affected.
